# Elements

### Alpha Contract Owner

The system SHALL define the exchange format for alpha data.

#### Metadata
  * type: requirement

#### Relations
  * definedBy: [Exchange Format](#exchange-format)
  * specify: [Alpha Left](Capabilities.md#alpha-left)
  * verifiedBy: [Shared Proof](Verifications.md#shared-proof)
---

### Alpha Local

The system SHALL provide a local alpha service.

#### Metadata
  * type: requirement

#### Relations
  * specify: [Alpha Root](Capabilities.md#alpha-root)
---

### Alpha Parent

The system SHALL provide the shared alpha service.

#### Metadata
  * type: requirement

#### Relations
  * definedBy: [Shared Service Format](#shared-service-format)
  * derive: [Alpha Gap](#alpha-gap)
  * derive: [Alpha Middle](#alpha-middle)
  * satisfiedBy: [parent.txt](../evidence/parent.txt)
  * specify: [Shared Branch](Capabilities.md#shared-branch)
  * verifiedBy: [Parent Review](Verifications.md#parent-review)
---

### Alpha Gap

The system SHALL record shared alpha failures.

#### Metadata
  * type: requirement

#### Relations
  * derivedFrom: [Alpha Parent](#alpha-parent)
  * verifiedBy: [Gap Check](Verifications.md#gap-check)
  * verifiedBy: [Shared Check](Verifications.md#shared-check)
---

### Alpha Middle

The system SHALL process shared alpha requests.

#### Metadata
  * type: requirement

#### Relations
  * derive: [Alpha Implemented](#alpha-implemented)
  * derivedFrom: [Alpha Parent](#alpha-parent)
  * verifiedBy: [Middle Demonstration](Verifications.md#middle-demonstration)
---

### Alpha Implemented

The system SHALL return a status for a shared alpha request.

#### Metadata
  * type: requirement

#### Relations
  * derivedFrom: [Alpha Middle](#alpha-middle)
  * satisfiedBy: [README.md](../evidence/README.md)
  * satisfiedBy: [alpha.txt](../evidence/alpha.txt)
  * satisfiedBy: [SKILL.md](../evidence/implementation/SKILL.md)
  * satisfiedBy: [AnalyzeCoverage.md](../evidence/skills/AnalyzeCoverage.md)
  * satisfiedBy: [AnalyzeModel.md](../evidence/skills/AnalyzeModel.md)
  * satisfiedBy: [ChangeImpact.md](../evidence/skills/ChangeImpact.md)
  * satisfiedBy: [Lint.md](../evidence/skills/Lint.md)
  * satisfiedBy: [SKILL.md](../evidence/skills/SKILL.md)
  * verifiedBy: [Shared Check](Verifications.md#shared-check)
---

### Exchange Format

An exchange record contains a nonempty text value.

#### Metadata
  * type: specification

#### Relations
  * define: [Alpha Contract Owner](#alpha-contract-owner)
---

### Shared Service Format

A shared service response contains a status value.

#### Metadata
  * type: specification

#### Relations
  * define: [Alpha Parent](#alpha-parent)
---

# Elements

### Beta Consumer

The system SHALL consume alpha exchange records.

#### Metadata
  * type: requirement

#### Contract Bindings
  * [Exchange Format](Alpha.md#exchange-format)

#### Relations
  * satisfiedBy: [beta.txt](../evidence/beta.txt)
  * specify: [Beta Root](Capabilities.md#beta-root)
  * verifiedBy: [Shared Check](Verifications.md#shared-check)
---

### Beta Gap

The system SHALL record rejected beta records.

#### Metadata
  * type: requirement

#### Relations
  * specify: [Beta Root](Capabilities.md#beta-root)
  * verifiedBy: [Beta Analysis](Verifications.md#beta-analysis)
  * verifiedBy: [Shared Proof](Verifications.md#shared-proof)
---

# Elements

### Alpha Root

Ability to provide the alpha services.

#### Metadata
  * type: capability

#### Relations
  * derive: [Alpha Left](#alpha-left)
  * derive: [Alpha Right](#alpha-right)
  * derive: [Empty Branch](#empty-branch)
  * specifiedBy: [Alpha Local](Alpha.md#alpha-local)
---

### Alpha Left

Ability to provide the left alpha services.

#### Metadata
  * type: capability

#### Relations
  * derive: [Shared Branch](#shared-branch)
  * derivedFrom: [Alpha Root](#alpha-root)
  * specifiedBy: [Alpha Contract Owner](Alpha.md#alpha-contract-owner)
---

### Shared Branch

Ability to provide services shared by both alpha branches.

#### Metadata
  * type: capability

#### Relations
  * derivedFrom: [Alpha Left](#alpha-left)
  * derivedFrom: [Alpha Right](#alpha-right)
  * specifiedBy: [Alpha Parent](Alpha.md#alpha-parent)
---

### Alpha Right

Ability to provide the right alpha services.

#### Metadata
  * type: capability

#### Relations
  * derive: [Shared Branch](#shared-branch)
  * derivedFrom: [Alpha Root](#alpha-root)
---

### Empty Branch

Ability reserved for future alpha services.

#### Metadata
  * type: capability

#### Relations
  * derivedFrom: [Alpha Root](#alpha-root)
---

### Beta Root

Ability to provide the independent beta services.

#### Metadata
  * type: capability

#### Relations
  * specifiedBy: [Beta Consumer](Beta.md#beta-consumer)
  * specifiedBy: [Beta Gap](Beta.md#beta-gap)
---

# Elements

### Service Verification Objective

This objective organizes verification of the alpha and beta services.

#### Metadata
  * type: verification-objective

#### Relations
  * derive: [Beta Analysis](#beta-analysis)
  * derive: [Gap Check](#gap-check)
  * derive: [Middle Demonstration](#middle-demonstration)
  * derive: [Orphan Check](#orphan-check)
  * derive: [Parent Review](#parent-review)
  * derive: [Shared Check](#shared-check)
  * derive: [Shared Proof](#shared-proof)
---

### Beta Analysis

This analysis checks rejection recording.

#### Details
Analyze the outcomes of invalid beta records.

#### Metadata
  * type: analysis-verification

#### Relations
  * derivedFrom: [Service Verification Objective](#service-verification-objective)
  * verify: [Beta Gap](Beta.md#beta-gap)
---

### Gap Check

This test checks alpha failure recording.

#### Details
Check that rejected shared requests produce a failure record.

#### Metadata
  * type: test-verification

#### Relations
  * derivedFrom: [Service Verification Objective](#service-verification-objective)
  * verify: [Alpha Gap](Alpha.md#alpha-gap)
---

### Middle Demonstration

This demonstration checks shared request processing.

#### Details
Demonstrate processing one shared alpha request.

#### Metadata
  * type: demonstration-verification

#### Relations
  * derivedFrom: [Service Verification Objective](#service-verification-objective)
  * verify: [Alpha Middle](Alpha.md#alpha-middle)
---

### Orphan Check

This test is intentionally without a requirement target to exercise orphan diagnostics.

#### Details
The fixture preserves an untargeted test as whole-model diagnostic input.

#### Metadata
  * type: test-verification

#### Relations
  * derivedFrom: [Service Verification Objective](#service-verification-objective)
---

### Parent Review

This inspection checks the shared service definition.

#### Details
Inspect the shared service response format for an explicit status value.

#### Metadata
  * type: inspection-verification

#### Relations
  * derivedFrom: [Service Verification Objective](#service-verification-objective)
  * verify: [Alpha Parent](Alpha.md#alpha-parent)
---

### Shared Check

This test checks service responses across both roots.

#### Details
Check shared alpha failure records, shared alpha status, and beta exchange consumption.

#### Metadata
  * type: test-verification

#### Relations
  * derivedFrom: [Service Verification Objective](#service-verification-objective)
  * satisfiedBy: [check.txt](../evidence/check.txt)
  * verify: [Alpha Gap](Alpha.md#alpha-gap)
  * verify: [Alpha Implemented](Alpha.md#alpha-implemented)
  * verify: [Beta Consumer](Beta.md#beta-consumer)
---

### Shared Proof

This proof checks exchange validity and rejected-record handling across roots.

#### Details
Establish that an accepted exchange value is nonempty and rejected beta records are recorded.

#### Metadata
  * type: formal-proof-verification

#### Relations
  * derivedFrom: [Service Verification Objective](#service-verification-objective)
  * satisfiedBy: [proof.txt](../evidence/proof.txt)
  * verify: [Alpha Contract Owner](Alpha.md#alpha-contract-owner)
  * verify: [Beta Gap](Beta.md#beta-gap)
---
